text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD: #4521) - inference-queue-saturation (autoscaler lag).
incident-bot: Summary: sustained queue depth > 1200 for 3m, scaling rate below expected. Region: eu-west-1. Impact: elevated latency and some 503s.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page triggered -> Sam (oncall). Escalation policy: oncall->sre->capacity.
Sam (oncall): ack. I'm looking at autoscaler metrics now.
Sam (oncall): grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/inference/queues?panel=eu-west-1 shows queue depth spike starting at 12:02 UTC.
Sam (oncall): logs (sampling):
```
2026-03-17T12:03:15Z queue_size=1387 autoscaler_rate=0.9 req/s desired_replicas=45 running_replicas=34
2026-03-17T12:05:02Z scale_attempt=failed reason="quota_exceeded"
```
Tia: seeing same. Autoscaler kept throttling because nodepool quota reached for this account. Customer-facing dedicated pools unaffected.
Jordan: Can we do a manual spin? `infractl nodepool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool inference-hot --replicas 60`
Nora: quota is shared across teams; hitting soft limit. Need quota override or a different pool. I'll check quota request status.
Sam (oncall): trying manual scale to reserved fallback pool: `infractl nodepool attach --from shared-surge --to inference-hot --count 8`
InfraBot: Command accepted. Request id: req-9f4b. Provisioning nodes...
InfraBot: Provision result: 6 nodes ready, 2 pending (pending due to spot fulfillment).
Sam (oncall): after 6 nodes came up, queue depth dropped from ~1400 -> ~600 in 90s, latency tail improved but still elevated.
Tia: Recommend immediate traffic steering for critical tenants to dedicated-hotpool (low risk) while we finish scale. Can we flip routing at edge for corp customers?
Jordan: routing change: `routerctl route set --match "org:corp-" --target dedicated-hotpool --weight 100` (needs ops-approval).
Nora: ops-approval granted by @Nora. Proceed with caution; watch for cold-starts.
Sam (oncall): applied routing for corp-*. Observed 200 qps move. Overall queue drops further.
Tia: Also enable fallback smaller model for non-critical requests to reduce token cost and inference time: `deployctl rollout --model rwd-small-v2 --selector noncritical=true`
Jordan: rollout in progress. Suggest disabling long-batch window to reduce in-flight latency: `runtimectl config set batching.window_ms 50`
Sam (oncall): reduced batching window. That immediately reduced tail latency at the cost of slightly higher per-token cost.
Sam (oncall): current customer impact (from telemetry): 12% of requests in eu-west have >2s generation latency for last 5m, error rate 0.6% (baseline 0.1%). Major corp tenants on dedicated route are OK. Public traffic improved after routing change.
Tia: Good mitigation. We should escalate to capacity team for quota bump and follow up with infra to adjust autoscaler growth policy.
Nora: I've opened a support/infra ticket with priority-high linking to PD #4521 and quota request Q-8871.
Sam (oncall): PD escalation to capacity team initiated. Marking incident as ongoing.
Jordan: For longer term: autoscaler policy tweak: increase max-step, allow burst to spare-pool for 10m, and add pre-warm for high-traffic forecasts. I'll file a follow-up RFC.
Sam (oncall): handoff plan: I've stabilized primary impact with routing + manual nodes. I'll stay on for another 30m, then hand to Tia for monitoring and follow-up. Note for next oncall: watch eu-west pending nodes and PD Q-8871 ticket.
Tia: taking over at 12:20 UTC. I'll watch metrics and confirm quota outcome.
Sam (oncall): Thanks team. Incident notes: created internal incident thread https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1292. Add any postmortem items there.
Nora: Added note: customer outreach needed for corp-45 and corp-21 — assign CS.
InfraBot: PD #4521 status updated -> acknowledged by Sam; escalated to capacity.
Sam (oncall): closing active mitigation loop. Leaving handover logs in runbook: `/docs/runbooks/autoscale_backlog.md` -> appended timeline and commands used.
Tia: acknowledged takeover. Will update when quota resolved or if any regression. :thumbsup:
